## What's new in plus-9

### Card badges you can tell apart
Corner numbers on cards used to be the same translucent black chip. Each now has its own look,
in the current theme's colors:

- **Unwatched episodes** — a pill in the "watched" check-mark color
- **Versions** — an outlined "files" icon with the count in the accent color, now also on home page rows
- **Collections** — a "stack" icon with the number of movies, plus how many are left once you
  have started the collection, and a check mark when it is fully watched
- **Episode number** — a neutral outlined chip; on the home page it includes the season ("S3 E2")

### Playlists that look like collections
- Video playlists open as a **poster grid** with header, view options, sorting (including the
  playlist's own order) and filters. A **Grid view / List view** button switches the layout, and
  the choice is remembered for each playlist
- **Remove from playlist** on long press in the grid (when you can edit the playlist)
- New **Playlists tab** in movie and TV libraries
- Fixed: **genre and parental-rating filters** were empty in playlists
- Fixed: with "Group movies into collections" on, **movies in a playlist were replaced by their
  collections** (e.g. 81 entries out of 100) — in the list, the grid and playback

Everything from plus-8 is still included: Signal theme, watched-progress bar, alphabet bar with
present letters only, regrouped player controls, Dolby Vision Profile 7 → 8.1 conversion and
direct play for `DOVIInvalid` (both experimental, off by default). Screenshots are in the
[README](https://github.com/SergeiAK/Wholphin-plus#new-in-plus-9).
